## Description

Used in [Start Healing Modification](/wiki/articles/start+healing+modification). Specifies which of the action's inputs will be continuously reevaluated. The action will keep asking for and using new values from reevaluated inputs.

- **None** 
- **Receivers and Healers** 
- **Receivers Healers and Healing Percent**
